div.div: وَبِرٌ A camel having much وَبَر [i. e. fur, or soft hair]; (S, M, * A, * Msb, K;) and in like manner, a hare or rabbit, and the like; (K;) as also ↓ أَوْبَرُ : (S, M, A, K:) fem. of the former, وَبِرَةٌ; (M, A, Msb, K;) and of the latter, وَبْرَآءُ. (M, A, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
